title: Account Maintenance Basis for Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts
content:
On an account under Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts the route a tank sits on is set by where the tank is and is changed only when the tank moves, not because the member would prefer a different delivery day.

**Tank size.** A change of tank size is a service call and a fresh leak check where the programme requires one, and the new capacity is recorded from the technician's work order.

**The automatic schedule.** Enrolling or leaving the automatic keep-full schedule is the member's own decision and takes effect from the next route run rather than immediately.

**The level instalment.** The level monthly instalment is rewritten only at enrolment and at the plan reconciliation, never on request part way through a plan year, because the instalments are what spread the estimate.

**The contracted price.** The clause formerly stated here — "The contracted price on the account is written from the booking and is never edited on its own." — is carried for the record and is no longer in force as the basis on which the contracted price carried on the account is arrived at.

**Tank rent's due date.** It moves only when a tank is set, pulled or relocated.

**When maintenance may be done at all.** An account is updated only while it stands in active, seasonal hold or past due, since a closed account is finished. What settles this is the standing the system carries on the account, read against the account number before the change is made.

## Changes and their effect, as a table

| The member asks for | The basis |
| --- | --- |
| A different delivery day | The route follows where the tank is; it changes only when the tank moves |
| A larger or smaller tank | A service call, and a fresh leak check where the programme requires one; the new capacity is recorded from the technician's work order |
| To join or leave the automatic schedule | The member's own decision, effective from the next route run |
| A different monthly instalment mid-year | Not rewritten part way through a plan year; only at enrolment and at the plan reconciliation |
| A change while the account stands closed | Not made; a closed account is finished |

*Hypothetical.* A member on the automatic schedule asks on a Tuesday to come off it, and the tank's route is next run the following Monday. The change takes effect from that next route run, not on the Tuesday.

superseded_clauses: The contracted price on the account is written from the booking and is never edited on its own.
